cession.description: The original holder cedes its claim and administration of the land as well as any attached claims to the new holder. The original holder may later reassert a claim to the land.

territory.description: Establishes a territory, administered under a territorial government under the government granting the territory.

annexation.description: Annexing a rebellious area results in an occupation

territorial claim.description: Grants a claim to a territorial land held by another state or country. The granter must hold a claim, and does not lose this claim through the grant.

occupation.description: A claim is enforced through military invasion of the territory. The original holder retains a claim but no longer administers the area.

condominium.description: Two nations agree to share administration of a territory. Both nations retain a claim to the area.

survey clarification.description: A survey revealed that an area held by the original holder should have been held by the new holder instead.
